violation_type.typical_finding: The air conditioning unit in the backyard is accessible to children with no fencing or barrier.

finding_variants.text: The air conditioning unit in the backyard is accessible to children with no fencing or barrier.
The AC unit located in the backyard area was observed to be uncovered and accessible to children in care.
